notes: On 20 April 2023, troops of 21 Armored Brigade of Operation Hadin Kai, 199 Special Forces Battalion and Civilian JTF clashed with dozens of Boko Haram [JAS] militants at Ukuba and Garin Glucose in Bama LGA (Borno). 9 militants were killed others escaped with bullet wounds, one truck and two 122 artillery guns were recovered by the troops, some women who were held by captive were rescued during the operations which lasted three days.

notes: On 30 August 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack on a Christian town in Borno (location coded to Maiduguri, Maiduguri Metro). A church and school were burnt. No reported injuries or fatalities.
Looting: On 26 December 2023, ISWAP raided and looted drugs from a Primary Health Care center in Mainok (Kaga, Borno).

On 14 November 2021, members of a Zamfara militia numbering up to a hundred attacked Kwarin Mai Saje (Tsafe, Gusau), coded as Tsafe, raped an unspecified number of women, abducted six persons and looted valuables. The attack was a punitive measure on the village over its failure to pay a levy imposed by the militia.

On 12 January 2024, the Nigerian police arrested a Kaduna militia's kingpin around the Abuja-Kaduna Road flyover by Rido Junction, coded to Rido (Chikun, Kaduna). The kingpin was responsible for many high-profile attacks and abductions in the area. The police recovered forty- eight AK-47 rifles from him.

Security measures: On 23 January 2024, the governor of Plateau state imposed a 24 hour curfew on Mangu LGA (Plateau) following violence which broke out in different parts of the town [coded separately].

On 29 July 2022, an unidentified armed group abducted a gold miner and his driver along Ilesa-Oshogbo (Osogbo, Osun). A ransom of 100 million naira was demanded for the miner, the victims were released around 8 August after 20 million naira was paid as ransom.

On 10 March 2024, an unidentified armed group numbering six abducted a Chinese national from a guest house around Eyenkorin in Ilorin (Ilorin West, Kwara) where he was lodged. The police claimed to have arrested three suspects in connection with the abduction. The abductee was rescued on 19 March by operatives of the state police command (there are no further details on ransom payment or a clash).

On 27 January 2022, a group of motorists tried to attack a soldier at a checkpoint at the Onitsha Bridgehead (Onisha North, Anambra) after a revenue collector was killed by a stray bullet. Reinforcement of soldiers were deployed to dispel the motorists, and the soldier was unharmed.

On 26 May 2020, Police officers attacked and detained a group of officers from Lagos State Building Control Agency during an inspection in Aja (Eti-Osa LGA, Lagos). They also shot in the air. No fatalities and/or injuries reported.

Weapons seizure: Around 9 May 2024 (as reported), the Nigerian troops intercepted weapons from three gunrunners in the Sukuk community, coded to Kirsinga (Madagali, Adamawa). A locally fabricated Gun, a pistol, 59 rounds of 7.62 mm x 39 ammunition, two locally fabricated guns and 29 cartridges were recovered.

Property destruction: Around 24 April 2024 (as reported), Nigerian troops and Katsina state Civilian JTF cleared suspected hideouts of Katsina militias at Shawu, Dugun Fakwu and Tafki villages in Faskari LGA (Katsina). One fabricated gun and other weapons were recovered.

Property destruction: On 9 June 2022, Bassa Kwomu militiamen set eight houses ablaze including the palace of the traditional ruler when they invaded Mozum (Bassa, Kogi). The militiamen were suspected to have been hired from Agatu in Benue state, the attack was a reprisal for the murder of a palm wine tapper [coded separately].

Around 13 February 2022 (as reported), Nigerian troops carried out airstrikes against ISWAP camps in Tumbun Kaiyowa (Abadan, Borno), Tumbun Madayi, Tumbun Allura, Parisu and Njimia [coded separately]. Five militant leaders were killed in the strikes across the locations, five fatalities split across five events, coded as 1.

Around 8 August 2021 (between 7 August - 8 August), the Nigerian police arrested over 20 unidentified cult militias in various locations within Oshogbo (Osogbo, Osun). The cultists were picked up when the police raided some black spots.
On 9 September 2023, a Katsina militia abducted two persons from Marke village (Dutsinma, Katsina) coded to Dutsin Ma. There are no reports on ransom demands.
Security measures: On 30 January 2024, the Osun State Government imposed a 12-hour curfew in Ilobu and Ifon, coded to Ifon (Orolu, Osun), over communal clashes between the two communities.

On 8 November 2023, the Nigerian Air Force of Operation Hadin Kai launched air strikes against the ISWAP position at Ajigin (Damboa, Borno). The air surveillance detected the gathering of the militants and launched the strikes, killing seventeen ISWAP fighters. Three of the militia's gun trucks were destroyed.
On 20 October 2020, unidentified gunmen abducted two Christian pastors and a worshipper along Ubulu-Unor/Ogwashi-Uku road (Aniocha South LGA, Delta). Victims released after paying ransom.
